spec: §15 suite C (T3 for borrow frames); §5.6: the frame factorises as P' x I_B, independent of the borrowed value
derivation: borrowed runs CX x,b; CX b,t; CX x,b; CX b,t (V;W;V^-1;W): t ^= (b^x) then t ^= b, net t ^= x with b restored. (t,x) = (0,1) -> t=1 (key mut then in: 11). The CLI starts borrowed wires in |0> (README run-action); independence from b itself is the §5.6 factorisation the spec's rule requires, partially observed here through the single available b entry value.
